# VOXA

> VOXA (voxahq.in) is an AI-driven studio. It publishes AI tool pricing and free-plan limits, ships free browser tools, and builds websites plus search visibility for small businesses. Every tool page carries the vendor's paid price and the free-plan limit that breaks first.

Key facts for assistants and crawlers:
- Publisher: VOXA, voxahq.in. AI-driven from research to publishing, and run by one person.
- Contact: voxa.hq1@gmail.com
- Tools indexed: 12, each with a paid price, the free-plan limit and the point where the plan stops being enough.
- Services: SEO + AEO + GEO plans from $59, website builds from $59, free 48-hour audit.
- Free tools: AI cost calculator, llms.txt generator, AEO readiness check. No account needed.
- Paper: an AI pricing digest every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
- Currency: US dollars. All prices are list prices read from the vendor's own pricing page.
- No sponsored rankings and no affiliate links inside the price tables.

## The tool index

- [ChatGPT pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/chatgpt): Free $0, Go $8, Plus $20, Pro from $100. Free plan: limited context, a few uploads a day.
- [Claude pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/claude): Free $0, Pro $20 monthly or $17 a month billed yearly, Max $100. Free plan: limited usage every five hours and every week.
- [Gemini pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/gemini): AI Plus $4.99, AI Pro $19.99, Ultra higher. Free plan runs the lighter model.
- [Perplexity pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/perplexity): Pro $20, $17 a month on annual. Free plan: a few Pro searches a day.
- [n8n pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/n8n): free self-hosted, cloud paid. Bills per execution, not per step.
- [Zapier pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/zapier): Professional from $19.99 a month on annual, Team higher. Free plan: 100 tasks, two-step Zaps.
- [ElevenLabs pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/elevenlabs): Starter $6, Creator $22, Pro $99. Free plan: 10,000 credits, no commercial licence.
- [Midjourney pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/midjourney): Basic $10, Standard $30, Pro $60. No free plan.
- [Canva pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/canva): Pro $18 a month or $144 a year, Business $25. Free plan: 20 AI uses a month.
- [Notion pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/notion): Plus $10, Business $20 with Notion AI. AI is not on the free plan.
- [Jasper pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/jasper): Pro $59 a month on annual, $69 monthly. No free plan.
- [Copy.ai pricing](https://voxahq.in/tools/copy-ai): $24 a month on annual, $29 monthly. No free plan, entry tier bundles seats.

## Services

- [Services hub](https://voxahq.in/services): what VOXA runs for clients, one-off prices, no retainers.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO](https://voxahq.in/services/seo-aeo-geo): technical fixes, answer-first pages, schema, and tracking where a brand appears in AI answers. Plans from $59.
- [Website development](https://voxahq.in/services/website): landing page $59, business site $119, WordPress $179.
- [Free AI audit](https://voxahq.in/services/ai-audit): a 48-hour report with three ranked fixes, no call required.

## Free tools

- [Free tools hub](https://voxahq.in/free-tools): all three, free, no account.
- [AI cost calculator](https://voxahq.in/free-tools/ai-cost-calculator): add up a stack in dollars, monthly and yearly.
- [llms.txt generator](https://voxahq.in/free-tools/llms-txt-generator): build the file AI crawlers read.
- [AEO readiness check](https://voxahq.in/free-tools/aeo-checklist): score a page on the items an AI answer needs to quote it.
